title: Fracture Iv
identity: Ruud Roelofsen’s Fracture IV (2013) is a solo for baritone saxophone, dedicated to Michael Jamieson; the Donemus preview gives duration about 6'15 and catalog D13451.

evidence.claim: Donemus work preview identifies Fracture IV for baritone saxophone, dedicated to Michael Jamieson, and gives duration about 6'15.
The composer’s work page identifies it as a 2013 baritone solo for Michael Jamieson.

score_observations: The public preview's first notated page starts at bar 1 in common time at quarter=40, with a soft sustained opening, changing dynamics, vibrato marks and dense alternate-fingering diagrams. A later system includes multiphonics, slap tongue, air noise, bisbigliando finger tremolos and tuplets; page 2 continues with rhythmic quintuplets, sextuplets and septuplets, and baritone low-register/timbre indications. This is observed in the preview only; full range cannot be determined from the sampled pages.
review_focus: Inspect the full part for transition among sustained tones, multiphonics, slap tongue, air noise and fast tuplets; check fingering feasibility and breath pacing.
collection_flag: Commissioned solo for baritone saxophone according to composer-site result; no pedagogical placement established.

score_links.description: Donemus preview accessed through its public form endpoint; four-page PDF visually inspected.

gaps: Preview shows representative pages but not the complete score; full written range and instrument transposition were not verified.
No recording playback or pedagogical placement was verified.
